bioconda.name: springsuite
bioconda.summary: The Spring Suite contains tools to predict and model protein-protein interactions from FASTA sequences and HHsearch threading results.

build.script:
PYVER=`python -c 'import sys; print(str(sys.version_info[0])+"."+str(sys.version_info[1]))'`
mkdir -p ${PREFIX}/lib/python${PYVER}/site-packages/
cp -r ./src/springsuite/spring_package/ ${PREFIX}/lib/python${PYVER}/site-packages/
cp ./src/springsuite/*.py ${PREFIX}/bin/
chmod +x ${PREFIX}/bin/*.py
